verdict.rationale: Extend clearly ships a Parse API whose output includes `chunks` and a `metadata` object, and its parsing docs cover figures, tables and agentic OCR. Nothing in the pack says the parsed output preserves headings, section hierarchy or reading order, so the capability this story asks about is unevidenced. Chunked output alone does not show structure preservation.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, parsed output preserves document hierarchy — headings, sections, reading order — so downstream LLMs see structure, not soup
